packing.scope: Sampled collision-envelope clearances and unsupported-subtree static gravity moments.

unverified: Continuous paths and poses outside the declared Cartesian samples and selected geometry pairs.
Physical geometry and tolerances; mesh distances use convex hulls, not concave CAD surfaces.
A support-plane bound below the required clearance is incomplete unless another sample proves failure.
Ground reactions, balance, leg loads and locomotion; samples need not be stable or reachable.
Acceleration, impact, friction, springs, actuator thermal limits and fatigue.
Controller reachability: configured actuator force caps do not prove available drive torque.
Bearing radial/axial force ratings, load paths, mounting stiffness and material stresses.
Hardware evidence for all estimated masses, capacities and geometry.

coverage.distance_fallback: Positive convex support-plane gaps certify lower bounds when native distances conflict.
coverage.sampling: Deterministic Cartesian groups; unsampled joints reset to home for each group.

assumptions: Installed assembly boxes include planning service space. Outer shell ellipsoids describe hollow containment, not occupied solid volumes.
The 729-point expression grid and independent five-point leg sweeps do not cover combined leg/expression motion or unsampled angles.

xm430.notes: Body depth excludes horn, idler and bracket extensions. Catalog CG origin has not been mapped; inertia remains centered surrogate. xl330.notes: 26 mm includes 23 mm case plus 3 mm horn. Optional idler requires 29 mm. Mounting configuration remains unqualified. Drawing output shaft is normal to W x H face, displaced +7.5 mm along catalog H from box center; planned shaft line is mapped, vendor CG frame remains unverified.

rmd.part: MYACTUATOR RMD-X4-P12.5-10, selected US revision unresolved
rmd.notes: Related global P12.5-10-C/E drawing; US selected listing could not be verified. Model retains 60 mm planning diameter and increases axial length to 56 mm.

assemblies.notes: Estimated assembly 550 g = nominal battery 506 g plus 44 g restraint allowance; maximum catalog mass 526 g leaves 24 g, so installed mass remains unqualified. Centered assembly inertia is estimated.
300 g is the total compute/storage/cooling/mount budget, not a measured kit mass. 120 x 110 x 65 mm is planning installation space; NVMe model, routing and airflow not qualified.
180 g total interfaces allocation includes known 18 g U2D2 pair. Other boards, IMU/audio and mounting are unweighed; additional 20 g foot sensors remain in the original ledger.
300 g torso power allocation includes five 7 g regulators, leaving 265 g estimated for distribution, wiring and mounts. Original leg wiring adds 50 g separately.
